accepted_claim.statement: Conditional on the predecessor source-scoped triple-point local fan/no-consecutive-D1 and clean-line charging premises already used to derive OM26-H1-RED-022, the sole q=5 score-95 equality normal form K3 plus two isolated triple cores is unrealizable. Hence any normalized n=18,T=95 witness must have q>=6 finite multiple points.

accepted_supporting_lemma.statement: For a D2 triangle of triple cores A,B,C, conditional on the no-consecutive-D1 local premise, at most one of A,B,C can simultaneously have (d2,d1)=(2,2).
proof_core: Two D2 rays at a triple core plus d1=2 and the no-consecutive-D1 premise uniquely force the local sector word (1,1,1,0,1,1).
For two such vertices A and B, the D1 segments from A and B to the intersections with the third core-line L_C have ordinary endpoints.
The second counted face across each such D1 segment forces L_C to intersect both disjoint outward rays of AB.
A line distinct from AB intersects AB in at most one point, yielding a contradiction.
accepted_supporting_lemma.coordinate_cross_check: The equivalent affine normalization forces alpha+beta<1 and alpha+beta>1 simultaneously; cyclic variants force alpha>gamma and alpha<gamma, and beta<gamma and beta>gamma.

resulting_frontier.remaining_gap: All q>=6 score-95 configurations remain open. The predecessor local fan and clean-line charging premises remain source-scoped obligations for an unconditional proof.
